findings.claim: The Pages build uses a shallow checkout even though evidence generation requires historical Git objects.
findings.evidence: generate-evidence.mjs uses git log and git show, while the workflow checkout does not set fetch-depth and the Flint asset names a different commit from the tested head.
findings.suggested_fix: Make evidence source identity independent of shallow history or fetch the required immutable objects, and keep regeneration invariant across merge strategies.

findings.claim: A clean checkout cannot pass native API verification because the diff adds only the native manifest, not the Dart/Rust artifacts the verifier assumes already exist.
findings.evidence: The packet diff includes website/static/native-api/manifest.json but omits the committed Dart and Rust artifact paths, so the reviewer inferred that the artifacts are absent.
findings.suggested_fix: Include a complete immutable inventory of the committed Dart/Rust outputs in the next review packet, or include the generated paths themselves.
